description: This file defines an abstract base class 'LogConsistentGrain<TView>' for grains that use log-based consistency protocols in Orleans. It includes lifecycle management, adaptor installation, and provider setup logic.

classes.name: LogConsistentGrain<TView>
classes.description: An abstract class for grains that implement log-based consistency, managing lifecycle participation and adaptor setup.

methods.name: InstallAdaptor
methods.description: Abstract method to install the log view adaptor with provided factory, state, grain type, storage, and services.

methods.name: DefaultAdaptorFactory
methods.description: Abstract property to get the default adaptor factory, or null if none.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to lifecycle stages and protocol participation if applicable.

methods.name: OnDeactivateState
methods.description: Handles deactivation, deactivating protocol participant if applicable.

methods.name: OnSetupState
methods.description: Initializes the log consistency provider and installs the log view adaptor during setup.

methods.name: PreActivate
methods.description: Pre-activation hook to activate protocol participant.

methods.name: PostActivate
methods.description: Post-activation hook to finalize protocol participant activation.

methods.name: InstallLogViewAdaptor
methods.description: Creates the view state and installs the adaptor.

methods.name: SetupLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Configures and retrieves the log consistency provider based on attributes or defaults.
